description:
Update a clueprint's metadata and/or file contents in one call.

Metadata fields (`name`, `description`, `tags`, `visibility`, `thumbnail_path`) are applied as a patch — only the fields you pass change. Pass at least one to update metadata.

`files` is a list of file mutations:
- Write text: `{ path, content }`
- Write binary: `{ path, content, encoding: "base64" }`
- Write from URL: `{ path, source_url }` (presigned URL, e.g. from get_clip with save=true)
- Delete: `{ path, content: null }`

You can mix writes and deletes in a single call. Existing files at the same path are overwritten.

`brand_locked`: true keeps the clueprint's own colors, fonts and logos for projects in this workspace; false (the default) re-skins them to each project's brand kit. Only this workspace's clueprints; a community clueprint is always re-skinned.

`decisions` records the build-time choices create_clueprint left pending, after you ask the user: animation_modes / image_modes ({id: mode}), voiceover_policies ({source_clip_id: policy}), split_decision, slide_count_strategy, allowed_element_types, the *_by_role variants for all-slides sources ({role: ...} from the *_by_role groups), and finalize_layout_texts: true (once every layouts/<NN>-<slug>/layout.md exists). Each applies on its own; failures come back in decision_errors.

brand_locked.description: true: projects built from it keep its own colors, fonts and logos; false: re-skinned to each project's brand kit.

clueprint_id.description: ID of the clueprint to update.

decisions.description: Build-time decisions to record (see the description).

animation_modes.description: {animation_id: mode}; user_uploaded = a logo animation the user uploads at build

files.description: File mutations — writes and deletes. Empty/omitted for metadata-only updates.

content.description: Text content, or base64-encoded binary if encoding='base64'. Set to null to DELETE this path. Omit (with source_url) when writing from a URL.

encoding.description: Set to 'base64' for binary files like images.

source_url.description: Presigned URL to download the file from. Server fetches and saves it. Use this instead of inline content for large/binary files.

thumbnail_path.description: Relative path of a screenshot in the clueprint to use as thumbnail (e.g. 'screenshots/title-slide.png').

name: update_clueprint
title: Update clueprint
